name: figma-implement-design
title_zh: Figma 链接一贴，代码按稿子长出来
tagline_zh: 最烦的不是写不出组件，是写完和稿子差 4px 还得来回截图比对。它把设计上下文、切图。
tagline_en: The pain isn't writing the component, it's the 4px drift and endless screenshot diffing. It reads design context.
desc_en: 把 Figma 节点翻译为生产级代码，用 Figma MCP 工作流实现 1:1 视觉还原（设计上下文、截图、资源、项目约定转译）。当用户给出 Figma 链接或 node ID，或要求实现必须对齐 Figma 稿件的设计 / 组件时使用。需要可用的 Figma MCP 连接。
why_zh: 不是照着截图猜样式，而是通过 Figma MCP 拿到节点真实的设计上下文。
why_en: It doesn't guess styles from a screenshot; it pulls real design context from the Figma node via MCP, then translates it into.
limit_zh: 必须能连上 Figma MCP，连不上它一步都走不了；只覆盖 Figma 到代码这一格，不做设计评审、不改稿。
limit_en: Requires a working Figma MCP connection — without it, nothing runs. Covers only Figma-to-code; no design review, no editing the file, no Figma-side.
title_en: Paste a Figma link, get code that matches the frame
